question: Prime Minister Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana approved in July 2025 aims to benefit how many (in crores) farmers initially?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1.7 crore farmers**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The **Prime Minister Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana** was approved in **July 2025** to strengthen the agricultural sector and ensure the welfare of farmers across India.
 
• The scheme primarily aims to benefit an initial target of **1.7 crore farmers**, focusing on small and marginal farmers who constitute the majority of the agricultural workforce in India.
 
• It is designed to provide financial assistance, modern farming techniques, and access to market linkages to ensure better productivity and profitability for the farmers.
